University of Europe — M.Sc. Data Science thesis (Overleaf)

1. Upload this ZIP to Overleaf (New Project → Upload Project).
2. Menu (top left) → Main document → select overleaf_main.tex
3. Compiler: pdfLaTeX (default on free plan)
4. Recompile. If bibliography is empty on first pass: click Recompile again (or enable auto-compile).

Before binding, edit overleaf_main.tex:
  \Matrikel, \Erstbetreuung, \Zweitbetreuung, \Abgabedatum

Figures: architecture.png and rq3_bars.png are included. If a figure path is missing, a placeholder box appears (see preamble \maybeincludegraphics).

Character count: UE counts body text without spaces (see docs/thesis/ADMIN_CHECKLIST.md in the GitHub repo).

Separate project: colloquium slides are in colloquium_slides.tex in the repo (not in this ZIP).
